statement: The integral generated Albanese quotient is the connected point group of the large one-motivic Chow Albanese sheaf
depends_on: AyoubBarbieriViale2009 Lemmas1.1.6/1.3.3; Corollary1.3.5; Proposition1.3.11; Lemma1.3.12; Theorem3.1.4; smooth compactification and Chow localization
notes: Exact integral sheaf quotient over C; no finite-dimensional representability asserted. Nonproper parameters are handled on free zero-cycles and projective compactification, not by a false CH0 pushforward. Full morphic comparison remains an additional conjecture; finite Walker comparison is refuted in E.3u.

statement: N is killed by full morphic Abel-Jacobi; a morphic family map is zero exactly when its rational Lawson cylinder is zero
depends_on: Walker2007Morphic Example5.5; Theorem5.7(1)-(4); Corollary5.9; Proposition3.3; strict Hodge filtration; countability of integral Lawson homology
notes: For every smooth projective complex X and every abelian family. Includes u_Z tensor Q zero implies Lawson cylinder zero. Full morphic target is distinguished from the finite-dimensional coniveau Walker Jacobian.

statement: The complex converse to Theorem3.1 is false even rationally, for a specified codimension-four elliptic family on a sixfold
depends_on: E.3t; Friedlander2000 Theorems3.2/3.4 and Proposition5.1 with proofpp1095-1097; Nagel2002 Theorem3.13 and C.1i degree14 certificate; Walker2007Morphic Theorem6.2 proof
notes: Y is the geometric generic degree14 section of split Q6 with65891 independent coefficients; gamma is the difference of the two specified plane sections; X=Y times E:y2=x3-x. Z=gamma times normalized diagonal has zero integral cohomological class and an injective rational Lawson cylinder. The specified geometric generic e yields a nontorsion class modulo N after every complex embedding. Thus N^4 is strictly smaller than the finite Walker kernel=A*H. Corrected universal necessary criterion is E.3t; positive support cases remain valid.
